items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: they had Tony Brilia (brass) they had a lot of guys that didn't stay after it became cooperative

ctx.x: That was much later on. It became a cooperative band. The name is on the tip of my tongue, but they got him out and he had the band and they had all -- they had Tony Brilia (brass) they had a lot of guys that didn't stay after it became cooperative, the bass player, the piano player --
